title: NO MEDICAL NAG ON THE KIA CARD
why: His question of 2026-10-12 about the death card: YOU DIED CARRYING MEDICAL YOU NEVER USED, soooo random, why is that where it is. It was a hint added in v13.15 from his early telemetry (medical carried on every run and applied on none), tacked onto the end of the KILLED BY line, so it sat in the middle of the facts of the death as a random nag. The KIA card now says what killed you, with what and how far from extraction, and nothing else on that line. The fact is still recorded for the run report.
now: The KIA card no longer nags about medical you carried and did not use.
